policies.title: Verified adults only
policies.body: Requester and companion accounts require ID and selfie checks. The pilot is strictly 18+.

policies.title: Nonsexual scope
policies.body: Sexual services, coercion, undisclosed role changes, and off-platform payment are blocked and reviewed.

policies.title: Public venues first
policies.body: First-launch bookings are limited to public venues or approved formal event spaces.

policies.title: Live support loop
policies.body: Arrival, mid-event, and exit check-ins route to support and the requester's trusted contact.

policies.title: Escrow protection
policies.body: Funds are held until the event closes, with cancellation and incident policies applied by operators.

policies.title: Manual review
policies.body: Low ratings, missed check-ins, boundary reports, and cancellations enter human review before rebooking.

scenarios: Approve if the event is at a public venue, both users verify identity, and the companion completes a video intro before arrival.
Approve with business-dinner posture, alcohol limits, no romantic cover story, and mid-event check-in.
Approve with arrival/exit plan, rideshare-safe pickup zone, and explicit non-romantic expectations in the event brief.
Approve only if the cover story stays lightweight, no long-term deception is required, and both parties consent to the role.
Pause the booking, notify support, document the boundary change, and preserve companion pay if the requester violated scope.
Block the request, warn or suspend the requester, and route the booking record to safety review.
Alert support, contact both parties, share the last known event brief with the trusted contact, and keep the incident open.
Apply the cancellation window, compensate the companion for protected time, and keep escrow records attached to the booking.

integrations.name: Identity
integrations.detail: Ready to swap from sandbox badge checks to hosted ID and selfie sessions.

integrations.name: Payments
integrations.detail: Escrow estimate is local today; event completion can later capture or release funds.

integrations.name: Support
integrations.detail: SOS demo creates an operator handoff payload without contacting emergency services.

integrations.name: Notifications
integrations.detail: Trusted-contact and check-in messages are modeled but not sent.
